static_traits.name: Emily
static_traits.social_status: 与其他乐手的关系因自信not足而紧张；有音乐朋友但not yet与他们讨论自己的without能感
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往without心理治疗或类似心理问题经历
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好、能进行自我Reflection，配合度高，态度积极

basic_info.main_problem: 我正为与打鼓skill相关的without能感和without价值感而困扰。问题始于我without法演奏一个我很喜欢的高难度鼓独奏，这让我认为自己是一个糟糕的鼓手。
basic_info.core_demands: 当这些without能感开始影响我对打鼓的热情和整体心理健康时，我决定寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: In a performance a few months ago, the client played a complex piece and performed perfectly, and the audience liked it very much; she attributed this success to long-term hard practice, and felt very proud and satisfied at the time.
过去在练习中曾学会新的打鼓技巧、也有过“把演出拿下”的时刻，但相较于最近在高难度独奏上的失败，这些既往成就被她视为微not足道。

core_beliefs: My value depends on whether I can perfectly perform a highly difficult solo

special_situations.event: 尝试演奏高难度鼓独奏却not yet能成功
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能把这个独奏演好，就说明I am not good enough、not配作为职业鼓手
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles practice, watches tutorials, seeks friends' comfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我因为一次失败就是个糟糕的鼓手

special_situations.event: Comparing oneself with other drummers who can play that solo with ease
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我达not到do not人轻松做到的水平，就说明我not如人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与朋友讨论困扰，Reduced socializing以避免比较与评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，也永远达not到他们的水平

special_situations.event: Recalls past successful performances and experiences of learning new techniques
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 当前的失败比过去的成功更能证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或忽视积极证据，继续沉浸在失败体验中
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些成功not算数，和现在的失败相比太微not足道了

special_situations.event: 练习该独奏时频繁出错
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果现在做not好，将来也not会做得好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated practice but lacking phased goals, continually seeking reassurance from others

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a capable drummer, to maintain self-worth and enthusiasm
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与not被认可，担心在同伴比较中被贬低
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control and avoids deeper vulnerability through self-criticism and labeling
通过加倍练习与寻求他人保证来暂时缓解Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、随时可能被失败定义的表演者
object_relations.object_representation: Others who succeed easily and are judgmental toward oneself (other musicians, audience)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When attempting a highly difficult solo and making mistakes, or when seeing others complete the solo with ease live / online
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把一次失败视为自身根本缺陷，认为他人会据此看低自己（将skill表现与自我价值绑定）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 先以温和、接纳的语气Empathy其羞愧与沮丧，再引导其区分skill与自我价值；use具体化Questioning与事实检验，避免批评性用语。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to recall and affirm past successes (such as a successful performance)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为过去的成功not足以证明当前能力，从而忽视正面证据
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a supportive tone, invites them to describe in detail the specifics of the success and the effort process, gently contrasts with current evidence, and encourages them to keep the positive side in their narrative.

manifestations: 将一次技术失败扩展为自我价值的negate
对打鼓的热情受影响，感觉“我not值得”
outcomes: 练习动力与日常作息受影响

manifestations: Living alone且not yet与朋友讨论自己的without能感
Relationships with other musicians strained by lack of confidence
outcomes: 羞愧感加剧与自我批评增加

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对他人或环境做出的行为冲动，或放弃向外寻求do not人为其做某事，转而对自己做；与“冲动”对应。
manifestations: have not与音乐朋友讨论自己的困扰
Turns the need to seek support into self-pressure and self-blame

contact_model.definition: 存在not良的自我Reflection与反省，包含过多的自我限制与自我苛责；与“自主性”对应。
manifestations: 频繁用“我永远not够好”“我是糟糕的鼓手”来给自己贴标签
过度关注错误而忽略进步

exception_events.target_problem: 在尝试高难度鼓独奏时，来访者通常会not断失误并认为自己永远not够好，进而Self-denial、练习Decreased drive。
exception_events.unique_outcome: A few months ago at a performance, the client perfectly played a complex piece, the audience responded enthusiastically, and she felt very proud at the time and confirmed her ability.
exception_events.reason: not同做法：事先投入了大量刻苦练习；not同支持：现场观众的积极反馈增强了信心；not同情境：演出状态Good、准备充分。

positive_force: Habit and perseverance of diligent practice (successful performances attributed to hard practice)
Past experience and evidence of mastering new techniques and successful performances (there are videos to rewatch)
Has music-circle friends as a potential social support resource
negative_force: 将单次失败泛化为整体能力的negate（过度概括、非黑即白）
灾难化预测“我永远not会好”，维持Anxiety
negate积极与心理过滤，过度关注失败证据
Over-relies on external guarantees while ignoring evidence of one's own existing successes

target_behavior.behavior: When performing or practicing difficult solos, strong self-deprecation and the labeling thought 'I am a bad drummer' appear
antecedent: 与其他鼓手进行能力比较
target_behavior.core_reason: 将skill表现与自我价值直接等同，并将一次失败过度概括为整体without能，同时对not yet来进行负向预测
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与羞耻感、寻求短期的控制与确定性（通过自我批评来“先行negate”）
target_behavior.consequence: 练习Decreased drive、Professional performance impaired、与其他乐手Relationship tension、Lowered self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: 在感到without能时过度寻求他人安慰与反复观看教程
antecedent: 练习中频繁出错并感到沮丧
回忆或面对他人轻松演奏同一独奏
target_behavior.core_reason: 内在自我价值not稳，过度依赖外部验证来缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 获得外部安抚以短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Limited help for long-term self-efficacy improvement, maintaining negative beliefs about own ability
